assertions.subject: Typhlitis
assertions.quote: Typhlitis is typically localized in the cecal area

assertions.subject: Acute appendicitis
assertions.quote: in acute appendicitis we may see a variable inflammatory involvement of the adjacent bowel

assertions.subject: Radiation colitis
assertions.quote: in radiation colitis there is a segmental involvement of the irradiated bowel

assertions.subject: Infectious colitis
assertions.quote: the extent of involvement may vary and can manifest as pancolitis

assertions.subject: Ulcerative colitis
assertions.quote: Bowel involvement is concentric and continuous in distribution in ulcerative colitis

assertions.subject: Crohn Disease
assertions.quote: in the majority of cases eccentricity, segmental distribution and greater prominence are found in Crohn Disease
